name: Getac EX80
statusNote: No longer in Getac's range; Getac names no Zone 0/1 successor.
summary: The Getac EX80 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ia) 8-inch Windows tablet from Getac, certified for Zone 1/21 under IECEx. Getac also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It runs Windows 10 Pro. It has been discontinued.

atex.marking: Ex ia op is IIC T4 Ga / Ex ia op is IIIC T135°C Da
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 4, checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not published

iecex.marking: Ex ia op is IIC T4 Ga / Ex ia op is IIIC T135°C Da

certification.northAmerica: UL 913 Class I and II Division 1 (Getac news)
certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ia) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)
certification.zone0Note: Zone 0 rated only inside the case supplied by the maker.

safety.conditions: Charge only in the non-hazardous area, with the adapter or cradle supplied by the manufacturer, within the ambient range of both charger and tablet. Data download via the cradle only to an unpowered device (flash drive). MicroSIM may be inserted or removed only in the non-hazardous area. No user-serviceable parts; battery pack is integral and not user-replaceable. Use only where there is a low risk of mechanical impact.
safety.peripherals: Charging cradle and data download in non-hazardous areas only; microSIM changes in non-hazardous areas only.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Not itemised in the certificate. Getac news lists a rotatable hand strap with kickstand and stylus holder, hard-tip stylus, charging dock, shoulder straps and office dock; their Ex status is not stated.

os.name: Windows
os.upgradeLimit: Windows 10 22H2 is the last Windows 10 version

specs.biometrics: Contactless smart card (HF RFID); TPM 2.0, BitLocker
specs.touch: Rain, glove and stylus touch modes

capabilities.label: RFID
capabilities.value: Built in (contactless HF RFID smart card reader)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (8 MP rear, Full HD webcam)

capabilities.label: Windows desktop software
capabilities.value: Built in (Windows 10 Pro, now out of support)

limitations: No longer in the maker's current range
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
